passages.excerpt_preview: In the Bairat message, the Beloved of the Gods honours the community of monks and nuns and recommends texts which, he says, should be heard and reflected upon.
ore than two and a half years have passed since I became a lay disciple, but for a year I did not exert myself strongly.
